operations.description: XRD patterns were collected on a Bruker-Nonius D8 Advance θ–2θ powder diffractometer with Cu Kα radiation (λ = 1.54 Å), a Bruker Sol-X Si(Li) solid-state detector, and a rotating stage. conflicts: The Ni:S ratio series shows changing relative Ni-metal byproduct; the source does not quantify the phase fraction for each ratio.

The article reports more Ni byproduct as the Ni:S ratio increases across the series; Figure 2F does not unambiguously identify a residual Ni peak for the 1:4 sample. Preserve the series-level statement separately from this panel assignment.
